notes: Authoritative record spec for the Nord state-gated reference race. Nord is the runtime-proven faucet (Kyne already scores humanoid/beast kills; Talos defiance +3 signal exists). DECISION 2026-06-07 (supersedes the old R5 'broad-only Shor/Tsun/Stuhn, Nord owns zero new deities'): Nord can FOCUS ANY GOD IN ITS CHOSEN PANTHEON. Per PDV_Phase2_DeityRoster_and_ArchitectureRulings.md the two pantheon lanes are: OldWays = Kyne(reuse) + Talos(reuse) + Shor/Tsun/Stuhn(NEW, Nord-owned); NineDivines = the 8 Divines(reuse, Imperial-owned: Akatosh/Mara/Arkay/Stendarr/Zenithar/Dibella/Julianos/Kynareth) + Talos(reuse). Nord now OWNS THREE NEW deity records (Shor, Tsun, Stuhn). GATE TYPE = state-enum-gated (R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_NordPantheonBaseline (OldWays|NineDivines) plus the focused patron's piety tier within that state; the focused patron is offer-like via the dawn-only offer gate, one active focus at a time. PROGRESSION CURRENCY = active-patron faucet (Kyne humanoid kills + Talos defiance) -- this is the reference pace, ~12 days to Devoted. Broad worship is a STATE on PATRON_STATE_BROAD (R1), NOT a deity -- there is NO PDV_Deity_OldWays / PDV_Deity_NineDivines. Broad OldWays T1 fills the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T1 (R2); broad OldWays T2 is PDV_Bless_Nord_OldWays_T2, capped at Faithful. NineDivines is the alternate pantheon-baseline state (PDV_State_NordPantheonBaseline=NineDivines); its broad lane reuses the same PATRON_STATE_BROAD reward path with Nine-Divines naming/framing. Broad blended favors stay SOFTER than focused patron rewards and are SUPPRESSED when a patron is focused (R8). Hircine routes through the Phase 20C Daedric system (R6), NOT a new record here. Themes: Kyne = open-sky/weather/stamina/beast-calm; Talos = martial resolve/defiance; Shor = Sovngarde hero-god, healing + martial honor; Tsun = god of trials/adversity, stamina + block + endurance; Stuhn = shield-thane, ransom/justice, armor + block. T3 Champion abilities additionally carry a scripted SIGNATURE on top of the stat half (signature design lives in PDV_Phase2_CapstoneSignatures.md; do NOT duplicate it here). T3 recognition = V1 Survey/status text only (Greybeard/Kyne/Nord status voiced topics are V2). Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No combat magnitude exceeds 12%.

nineDivinesLane.summary: Nine Divines lane (PDV_State_NordPantheonBaseline=NineDivines). Nord can focus ANY of the 8 Divines + Talos. The 8 Divine deity QUSTs are Imperial-owned (create:false; Nord reconciles Stance_Nord=NATIVE only). Talos is reused from the existing record and shares the Talos reward family above (lane=OldWays|NineDivines). Each focused Divine needs its own Nord-keyed 3-tier reward family: PDV_Bless_Nord_<God>_T1/T2/T3 -- same gods, Nord-flavored copy, distinct from the Imperial-keyed PDV_Bless_Imperial_<God>_* records (separate manager spell properties; do not reuse the Imperial spells).
nineDivinesLane.design: Per-god reward record editorIds declared as a compact contract (full 24-entry stat authoring deferred to the Nine Divines authoring slice; theme + magnitude shape locked here). Each family is state-gated on NineDivines + the focused god's piety tier (T1>=Seeker, T2>=Devoted, T3>=Champion), offer-like, one active focus at a time (mirror SyncKhajiitEmphasisFamily). Broad < focused; broad Nine Divines T2 suppressed under focus. All combat magnitudes <=12%; T3 carries the matching scripted signature from PDV_Phase2_CapstoneSignatures.md (Imperial Nine Divines block: Akatosh 'Endurance of the Covenant', Mara 'Compassion of the Mother', Arkay 'Ward of the Cycle', Stendarr 'Bulwark of Mercy', Zenithar 'Prosperity of Fair Dealing', Dibella 'Inspiration of Beauty', Julianos 'Insight of Law and Lore', Kynareth 'Open Sky').

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The Nord Survey also reports pantheon baseline (Old Ways vs Nine Divines), broad/focused state, primary patron (Kyne/Talos/Shor/Tsun/Stuhn in the Old Ways lane, or any of the 8 Divines + Talos in the Nine Divines lane), Kyne/Talos/Hircine tension, vampire/scar state, and active favor. Voiced NPC recognition lines (Greybeard/Kyne and Nord status topics) are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families only: broad lane (Layer 1: Old Ways OR Nine Divines per pantheon baseline, capped at T2/Faithful) + one active focused patron set (Layer 2: any focusable god in the chosen pantheon, T1/T2/T3). Only one focus is active at a time, so only one focused family is ever live. Broad stays softer than focused and is suppressed under focus. Hircine (20C Daedric) is curse-priced pressure, not a third always-on boon family. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Nord ceiling: 'Broad blended favors at Faithful stay softer than Devoted patron benefits. Kyne/Talos/Shor/Tsun/Stuhn/Divines/Hircine/Nord broad layers must not stack into a universal best build.' No combat magnitude exceeds 12%.
